status: frozen before v2 contrast generation and oracle outcomes
question: Can explicit pairwise source-grounded contrast evidence reject plausible adjacent-role hard negatives while preserving the true target, where simply adding more positive task evidence failed?

prior_evidence_boundary.v1_conclusion: more positive task evidence is rejected as the mechanism; v2 changes evidence structure to pairwise contrast rather than increasing positive prose

retrieval_boundary.candidate_set_for_hard_confusion_test: the fixed two concepts in each pre-existing hard-confusion pair

contrast_generation.source: canonical v31 preferred label, alternative labels and definition for both concepts in a fixed pair
contrast_generation.output_per_candidate: 0-4 verbatim source spans, each <=24 words, selected because it is comparatively useful for distinguishing that candidate from its paired peer
contrast_generation.source_grounding: every emitted span must validate as a normalized verbatim substring of that candidate's supplied canonical source evidence
contrast_generation.negative_fact_policy: never infer that the peer cannot perform an activity merely because it is absent from supplied evidence; contrast evidence is positive evidence for its own candidate only
contrast_generation.insufficient_source_policy: emit an empty list rather than invent a distinction

query_evaluation.reason_for_year: new independent time slice; 2022 was used by v1 and 2023/2024 by earlier display work

oracle_protocol.drop_semantics: only clearly semantically irrelevant according to supplied evidence
oracle_protocol.control: common v2 prompt with compact canonical evidence and no pairwise contrast spans
oracle_protocol.challenger: same prompt/evidence plus the precommitted pairwise contrast spans
oracle_protocol.contrast_semantics_in_prompt: contrast spans are positive source-grounded cues selected relative to the peer; their absence from the peer is never proof of impossibility or irrelevance

decision_gate.sample_valid: at least 40 cases across at least 8 fixed pairs
decision_gate.contrast_artifact_coverage: at least 8 fixed pairs have at least one validated contrast span for each side
decision_gate.target_safety: challenger target non-drop retention >=0.98 and no more than one additional target drop versus control
decision_gate.hard_negative_materiality: challenger paired hard-negative drop rate improves by >=0.20 absolute versus control
decision_gate.pair_breadth: at least 60% of evaluated pairs achieve challenger hard-negative drop rate >=0.50
decision_gate.if_pass: freeze exact contrast artifact and v2 oracle contract; then replay unchanged opened stress only as falsifier
decision_gate.if_fail: do not replay opened and do not distill; next reassess whether richer independent source domains or human judgments are required
